confidence_notes: Food anchors use Toulouse city-level prices updated in Oct 2026; the cocktail uses a current collaborative city estimate. Wine is estimated at about three quarters of the local draft-beer price. Lodging is a holistic, date-sensitive estimate without live listings; USD values are approximate.
comparable_city_reasoning: Direct Toulouse price observations anchor food and drinks; hostel and hotel estimates follow typical large French regional-city levels, adjusted for Toulouse's university and business travel demand.
